description: This file declares functions for batched matrix multiplication routines utilizing MKL (Math Kernel Library), with support for various data types including float, double, complex, bfloat16, and half precision. It appears to be part of PyTorch's internal ATen native CPU code, specifically for linear algebra operations optimized with MKL.
